terra.problem: “Brides-to-be wore one” sounds like all brides-to-be did this. Smith describes veil-wearing as exceptional, so “some brides-to-be” would be clearer.

The cited dictionaries do not say that the veil screened off the place where the ark was kept. Also, “the holy place” could be confused with the separate Holy Place; the ark was in the Most Holy Place.
Neither meaning clearly covers the veils used for magic in Ezekiel 13:18 or the figurative veil over people’s understanding in 2 Corinthians 3:14.
